messages:
tamir: rolled strict_validate -> 100% for canary-9 at 09:02. noticing a spike in fncall fallbacks and a small billing delta. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/boards/fncall-canary
sophia: numbers? rough % or absolute?
tamir: ~2.8x fallback rate vs baseline, ~120 extra billed tokens/min across canary hosts
infra-bot: Alert: fncall_fallbacks_total > 25 in 10m (canary-9)
sophia: can you paste a log sample? want to see if this is adapter vs validator behavior
tamir: sample:
```
{"req_id":"r_8c1d","route":"canary-9","fncall":"classify_v2","result":"fallback","reason":"unknown_keys","adapter":"go-adapter@1.4.2","tokens_billed":30}
```
mike_billing: quick flag: if we change billing attribution mid-rollout it will confuse quota owners. prefer billing to source_route until we have split attribution support.
ux_leah: Console UX problem: users see "Function failed" with no nuance. propose pill: `soft-fallback` vs `hard-reject` and a small tooltip: "Soft fallback = automatic coercion or validation fallback; may increase tokens." link to docs.
qa_jun: I can run a 20m synthetic load hitting canary-9 with trace sampling enabled to capture full request+response for 1% of fails.
sophia: telemetry: we currently emit fncall_fallbacks_total{route,reason} where reason is freeform. we should standardize to enum set and emit origin=adapter|validator|model and source_route.
tamir: agreed. proposed metric: `fncall_fallbacks_total{route,reason_enum,origin,source_route,route_tier}`. emit in parallel with old metric for 72h to avoid breaking dashboards.
mike_billing: sound plan. also ask billing team to log the mute window so we can reconcile customer invoices later.
ux_leah: for Console change: small front-end PR to show the pill in fncall table rows and a filter by `fallback_reason`. add a one-line explanation in the flow editor explaining billing implications.
infra-bot: Note: deploying validator PR with new labels will require a short feature flag window. recommend deploy at 02:00 UTC low-traffic slot.
tamir: short-term ops playbook while we iterate:
- mute billing spike alert for canary-9 for 60m
- enable 1% verbose tracing for fallback events (capture request+schema+adapter versions)
- emit new labeled metric in parallel for 72h
- Console: show soft vs hard pill and link to support doc
qa_jun: running synthetic now starting 7488880020, will post a small sample artifact here when done.
mike_billing: action: I'll create a billing log entry and coordinate with accounting for reconciliation.
sophia: action: i'll open the validator PR to emit `reason_enum` and `origin`, and add a feature flag toggle for per-route permissive mode.
ux_leah: action: I'll draft the Console pill copy and a help-center blurb for CS.
qa_jun: action: I'll run the 20m smoke and attach traces. expected finish +20m.
tamir: if fallback rate doesn't drop when toggling permissive->50% per-route, we rollback the full canary. otherwise continue rollout with labeled metrics. tagging @sophia @ux_leah @mike_billing for follow-ups.
qa_jun: synthetic run complete; uploaded sample traces at s3://trace-dumps/canary-9/run-748888. will analyze and surface adapter vs validator split in follow-up. :thumbsup:
